1.t: When Allah’s ˹ultimate˺ help comes and the victory ˹over Mecca is achieved˺

2.t: and you ˹O Prophet˺ see the people embracing Allah’s Way in crowds
2.tr: Wa-ra-aitan naasa yadkhuloona fee deenil laahi afwajaa

3.t: then glorify the praises of your Lord and seek His forgiveness, for certainly He is ever Accepting of Repentance
3.tr: Fasabbih bihamdi rabbika wastaghfirh, innahoo kaana tawwaaba
